title: OpenGL
author: JG
description: add textures to renderer (and add reset function), using numpy binary array representing RGB/RGBA image; reference numbers are then used in triangle lists
releaseNotes: SC.renderer.AddTexture(name, image, interpretation, flags) adds a texture from a numpy array of uint8 or floats in [0, 1], grey, RGB or RGBA, shared by all SystemContainers; RemoveTexture and GetTextureNames (revision2026c step RG6.11.2)
